description: Implement user-approved common preparation/send flow for text and attachments. Success adds no status text or edit. Failure preserves LLM body and appends safe reason; use existing placeholder if available, otherwise text-only notice, no upload retry. Keep original delivery result and canonical provider ID/callback semantics. Reuse DeliveryFiles.with_prepared, send_mode, create_and_dispatch_reply, edit_message and Thread.post. Local-only projection/orchestration, no new Action. File posts still require create because current adapters cannot edit attachments. Jad approved existing test changes explicitly via async response: no success edit, preserve answer/reason on failure, text-only notice without placeholder. Validate mix q and focused bridge/delivery tests; document upstream shared error contract debt. No history persistence or upstream adapter changes.
title: [PR #876] Unify outgoing chat delivery and preserve answers on file failure
